corrections.priorClaim: Failed AI Vault service construction soft-disables registration and startup survives.
corrections.sourceContract: Unsupported platform or an absent service soft-disables AiVaultHandler registration. RelayRuntimeServices calls createRelayAiVaultService without a catch before constructing AiVaultHandler. Service-client constructor initializes policy, not a child process; later process startup failure must be characterized separately. Arbitrary constructor-failure tolerance is not established.

deliveryCancellation.name: pty.deliveryCanceled
publicationPaths: rotation publishes superseded proof with replacement token
cancelExact publishes proof for a known nonclosed delivery, including detach/grace expiry
deliveryCancellation.explicitCancelRpc: Returns {canceled:true,sentEndSu,creditedEndSu}; does not publish this unsolicited notification. Owned recent proofs allow bounded idempotent replay; index limit256.
deliveryCancellation.pendingRecovery: Absent/same replacement token or conflicting replacement forces restore; otherwise records replacement token.
deliveryCancellation.normalConsumer: Safe integer sent/credited offsets and an active local provider generation are prerequisites. Calls intake proof application, then retires token identity; thrown proof errors retain identity. Wire providerGeneration is not directly compared here.
deliveryCancellation.openConsumerIssue: applySshPtySourceCancellationProof can return false when intake or matching obligation is absent, but this listener ignores the Boolean and still retires identity. Add a reproducer and determine intended lifecycle before changing behavior; not a reproduced defect or approved fix.
deliveryCancellation.liveness: Delivery retirement is not proof of remote process exit; preserve live/unverifiable/exited using owning-host evidence.
deliveryCancellation.remaining: No cancellation tests or real transport/skew/recovery execution in this slice; deeper credit coordinator validation and publication settlement remain open.
